digest.component_or_area: tracker initialization and environment identity management
propositions: Tracker re-clone mints a new .env-id without detecting existing events from a prior environment identity, silently orphaning all attestations signed by the old identity.
Environment identity is stamped into every event file and used as the principal for op-cert signature verification, but .env-id is git-ignored and not carried over on fresh clones.

Minting .env-id into a store that already contains events from a different environment must warn loudly on stderr naming the prior identity and the git-ignored files to carry over, with an override via REBAR_ALLOW_ENV_REIDENTIFY environment variable.

rebar fsck must emit a counted ENV_ID_MISMATCH check scoped by author, detecting when the current environment's author also wrote events under a different environment identity, without false-positives in multi-clone topologies.
Re-clone guard must complete and remain writable after warning, supporting the first-class workflow of a second clone mounting a shared tickets branch with its own identity.
